lines.en: I walk in small steps.
My tail drags on the ground.
My wings are not yet grown.
I walk among the mountain rocks.
My scales catch the light.
I climb step by step.
I head where the ore is.
My claws grip the rock.
Every two steps I sniff the ground.
The horns on my head are short.
I go around the loose stones.
All four claws find footing.
I sit on a rock.
My tail curls beside me.
I am watching the far mountains.
My scales are warming.
I have nothing to do.
I stretch my forelegs out.
I listen to the stones.
I gave a small sneeze.
My claw traces the ground.
I am waiting for an order.
I sit quietly.
I gaze at the distant summit.

lines.zh: 我数着岩缝里落下的土
lines.en: I count the dirt falling from the rock cracks.
I am a little bored.

lines.zh: 我凑近闻了闻你的膝盖
lines.en: I come close and sniff your knee.
My head tips sideways.
Are you a dragon as well?
My scales are not hard yet.
Do you want to touch them?
I can dig right through stone.
There's a meat smell in your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你踩石头的声音我认得
lines.en: I know the sound of you on stone.
I will keep following you.
Do not walk too fast.
My tail might trip you.
I tilt my head to hear you speak.
Your armor is bright.
I only bite proper prey.
I shuffled one step your way.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的靴子走了两步
lines.en: I follow your boots for two steps.
A sound squeezes from my throat.
I duck behind the rock face.
One scale cracked.
I do not care for that.
My tail struck the ground.
My four claws still hold.
You are really quite strong.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，牙咬得发响
lines.en: I crouch low, my teeth grinding.
I mark this spot.
I have not lost yet.
Is that piece meat?
I do eat meat.
Set it on that rock slab.
Let me touch it with my snout.
That smells rather good.
I do not eat much.
Is there a second piece?
I will take a piece.
Do not snatch it back.
When I finish, I can still mine.

lines.zh: 你的指缝里还带着肉味
lines.en: The smell of meat still clings between your fingers.
If I follow you, I eat.
You bumped my back.
I did not shift my place.

lines.zh: 你撞在鳞上，自己弹开了
lines.en: You strike my scales and bounce off yourself.
Step back a pace.
That was a small collision.

lines.zh: 我的尾尖勾住了你的裤脚
lines.en: My tail tip snags your trouser leg.
You stepped on my claw.
I shook my head about.
You did not bang your knee?
Watch where you walk next time.
My scales are still soft.
That waits until I am grown.

lines.zh: 这种话等我进化了再说
lines.en: Ask me that after I evolve.
Too early for that.
I only want to dig.
I scrape twice at the rock face.
I haven't learned that yet.
I flick my tail and walk on.
You are warm-blooded; I am a dragon.
Let me dig in peace.
I hold it between my teeth.
This is a little hard on the teeth.
I tuck it under my tongue.
It fell into a rock crack.
I dig it out with a claw.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把它推到你面前
lines.en: I push it in front of you with a claw.
There is dirt on it.
I bury it in the dirt at my den mouth.
Can you give me another?
This one is all shiny.
The stones moved over there.
I flatten down against the ground.
I lower my head, horn tip forward.

lines.zh: 我踏着碎石一步步逼近
lines.en: I close in step by step over the rubble.

lines.zh: 那东西横在我挖的道上
lines.en: That thing lies across my digging path.
I am not afraid of it.

lines.zh: 我把鼻尖凑到那影子前
lines.en: I bring my snout to that shape.
Get behind that boulder first.
My claws are out.
Three bounds and I am there.
It is bigger, but I am quicker.
My claws are already out.
I track along the rock face.
It went behind the rocks.
I dig open this crack.

lines.zh: 它每一步都踩在松土上
lines.en: Every step it takes sinks in loose dirt.
I am above it.
My claws bite into the rock seam.
It is backing toward the cliff.
I smell it.
I wait for you to nod.
It has nowhere left to go.

lines.zh: 我沿着碎石堆往斜里挪
lines.en: I creep slantwise along the rubble.
I am nearly in position.
I open my jaws at its hind leg.
I drive my horns in.
This bite is still shallow.
I shoved it aside with my head.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖在你袖口撕开一道
lines.en: My claws tear a seam in your sleeve.
It fell back; I follow.
It yelps as my teeth shut.
Go in and finish it.
My teeth are not all in.
I can bite you once more.
It ran into the rock.
That blow taught it manners.
I crawl out of the cave.
A small dragon joins the mountain.
There is stone dust on my scales.
I come over the loose stones.
I smell a person.
I come out of the mine.
My claw appears first.
This ground is mine to dig.
I lift my face toward you.

lines.zh: 你听见爪子刮石头了吗
lines.en: Did you hear claws on stone?
I am small, but sturdy.
I stop at your feet.
Fire curled my scales.
I slid down the cliff face.
My four claws thrash in the water.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我炸得翻了个身
lines.en: The blast flipped me over.
The arrow glanced off my scales.
The spell weakened my claws.
Hungry, and I cannot dig.
Lightning ran through my horns.
There is no stone to dig here.
